content.comment_body: Hello [user_name], I've been trying for some time to connect the [product_name] and access it via the Internet. I have a few questions: 1. Besides port 10001, should port 8080 be used as mentioned in the [product_name] manual? 2. Is the connection procedure for smartphones (using the [product_name] app) the same, or is a different process required? Thank you, [user_name]
Here is a link to download the manual for the app: [url]

Hello [user_name], I have the [product_name] and to get it online (outside your local network), you need to do the following: 1. If you have a static IP address, you can skip the next step. 2. For dynamic IP addresses that change periodically, you’ll need a hostname from a free DNS service (such as DtDNS). Download their IP update software—this will monitor your network's IP and update your hostname so you can always reach your [product_name] remotely. 3. Access your router settings and forward port 8080 internally to any chosen external port (for instance, 81), assigning it to the [product_name]'s IP. If your chosen app lets you select a port (like certain HMI apps do), set it there as well. Repeat these steps for any other required services. 4. Once configured, accessing your DNS hostname with the selected port (e.g., latest.dtdns.net:81) should bring you to the webserver or other services on your [product_name]. Hope this helps. Thank you in advance, [user_name]!

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are trying to remotely access their [product_name] modules over the Internet using [product_name] configuration tools and smartphone applications. There is some uncertainty regarding which network ports to use and whether configuration steps are the same for web and mobile access. Instructions for port forwarding, dynamic DNS solutions, and network setup have been shared, but the specifics for the official mobile app integration remain unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking detailed step-by-step guidance on choosing the correct ports for remote access and clarification on whether the same network procedures apply to both web access and smartphone app connectivity. They expect a reliable method to connect to their [product_name] from outside their local network.
